description: Spot anomalies with precision using our Anomaly Detect extension for Power BI Are you struggling to identify outliers in your data and understand performance inconsistencies? With Anomaly Detect, automate anomaly detection effortlessly, transform tedious manual checks into actionable insights. Identify anomalies and understand their context: This extension is designed to quickly and intelligently detect outliers in your key metrics, highlighting where and when your data deviates from normal patterns. By understanding anomalies in their context, you can take timely and impactful actions. Intelligent, focused detection: KPI Scoring: Automatically rank your KPIs by scoring the most relevant anomalies to focus on what matters the most. Quickly identify which metrics require immediate attention for deeper analysis. Automated anomaly detection: Leverage a sophisticated confidence interval and baseline calculation to automatically pinpoint outliers in your data. Customizable parameters: Adjust confidence levels, baseline points, and focus on anomalies above or below thresholds to match your analysis needs. Continuous monitoring: Enable "latest point only" mode for real-time alerting without overwhelming your dashboard with excessive anomalies.
